questions.question: Mirror adjustment can only be checked correctly if:

options.text: The trailer is straight.
There is no trailer.
The vehicle is on a slight incline.

questions.explanation: On a vehicle with one or more trailers, mirrors can only be adjusted correctly if the trailers are straight. Check mirror adjustment before every trip.

questions.question: What should you do if the brakes cannot build hydraulic pressure?

options.text: Upshift.
Downshift.
Hold the brake pedal down as far as it will go.

questions.explanation: If your brakes cannot build pressure, try shifting to a lower gear. You can also pump the brakes or use the emergency brake.

questions.question: When connecting a converter dolly to a second or third trailer, the trailer height should be:

options.text: Slightly higher than the center of the fifth wheel.
Level with the center of the fifth wheel.
Slightly lower than the center of the fifth wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slightly lower than the center of the fifth wheel.
questions.explanation: When connecting a converter dolly to a second or third trailer, the trailer height should be slightly lower than the center of the fifth wheel.

questions.question: Broken suspension parts:

options.text: Should be repaired right away.
Should be repaired, but not right away.
Cannot be identified.

questions.explanation: The suspension system holds up the vehicle and keeps the axles in place. Broken suspension parts are very dangerous and must be fixed immediately.

questions.question: Cargo tanks should never be completely full because:

options.text: Liquid needs room to expand when it gets hot.
Regulations require three feet of space between the liquid and the tank roof.
The tank would be too heavy.

questions.correctAnswerText: Liquid needs room to expand when it gets hot.
questions.explanation: Liquids expand as temperatures rise. You must leave extra space in the tank for this expansion. Different liquids expand different amounts, so know the expansion requirements for your load.

questions.question: Rollovers happen when:

options.text: You drive too slowly.
You are stopped.
You turn too fast.

questions.explanation: Rollovers happen when you turn too fast. Drive slowly on ramps and around corners. Avoid quick lane changes when towing trailers.

questions.question: A driver with a tank that has baffles should watch out for:

options.text: Front-to-back surge.
Side-to-side surge.
End-to-end surge.

questions.explanation: Baffles stop forward and backward surge, but they do not stop side-to-side surge. Side-to-side surge can cause rollovers.

questions.question: When parked on the side of the road, you should:

options.text: Use your taillights to warn other drivers.
Not worry about other drivers.
Turn on your four-way emergency flashers to warn other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your four-way emergency flashers to warn other drivers.
questions.explanation: When stopped on the roadside, turn on your four-way emergency flashers. This is especially important when visibility is poor. Place warning devices within 10 minutes of stopping.

questions.question: When backing with a trailer, you should start by:

options.text: Turning the steering wheel in the direction of the turn.
Turning the steering wheel in the opposite direction of the turn.
Turning the wheel as sharply as possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning the steering wheel in the opposite direction of the turn.
questions.explanation: When backing with a trailer, turn the steering wheel in the opposite direction of where you want to go. Once the trailer starts turning, reverse the steering wheel direction to follow the trailer.

questions.question: If transporting chlorine, what must be in the vehicle?

options.text: A gas mask
Goggles
An axe

questions.explanation: If transporting chlorine in cargo tanks, you must have an approved gas mask in your vehicle.

questions.question: What happens after two violations of state laws about hand-held cell phone use?

options.text: You must cancel your cell phone service.
Your CDL will be disqualified.
You must drive 10 mph slower than the speed limit for a set time.

questions.explanation: If you are convicted twice of breaking state laws about hand-held cell phone use, your CDL will be disqualified. Penalties get worse with more violations.

questions.question: How does texting while driving compare to talking on a cell phone while driving?

options.text: It is much safer.
It is just as safe.
It is more dangerous.

questions.explanation: Texting while driving is more dangerous than talking on a phone. Texting takes your attention away from the road and takes your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: Which sign shows that cargo may contain hazardous materials?

options.text: The cargo is in cylinder tanks.
The cargo comes from a supermarket.
The cargo is in cardboard boxes.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cargo is in cylinder tanks.
questions.explanation: The way cargo is packaged can show if it is hazardous. Cylinders and drums are commonly used to store and transport hazardous materials.

questions.question: Why are ice cream trucks a hazard to other drivers?

options.text: Ice cream trucks need to stay cold.
Children often run to ice cream trucks without checking for traffic.
Ice cream trucks leave water and ice on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Children often run to ice cream trucks without checking for traffic.
questions.explanation: Ice cream trucks create danger because they attract children. Children may not notice other vehicles when they run toward or away from ice cream trucks.

questions.question: What happens if air pressure is lost in the emergency line?

options.text: The service brakes activate.
The tractor protection valve closes.
The rear trailer detaches from the tractor.

questions.explanation: The tractor protection valve keeps air in the trailer brakes if the trailer breaks away or leaks. When air pressure is lost in the emergency line, the tractor protection valve closes and the emergency trailer brakes activate.
